questions.stem: In this diagram of where chemotherapy drug classes act across the cell cycle, why are the antimetabolite agents positioned to act specifically during the highlighted synthesis phase?

choices.label: A
choices.text: They block mitotic spindle assembly, which occurs during the S phase

choices.label: B
choices.text: They crosslink DNA in a cell-cycle-independent manner concentrated in the S phase

choices.label: C
choices.text: They interfere with nucleotide/DNA synthesis, which only occurs during the S phase

choices.label: D
choices.text: They arrest cells at the G1/S checkpoint before DNA is copied

choices.label: E
choices.text: They inhibit topoisomerase-mediated transcription unique to the S phase

explanation.summary: Antimetabolites are decoys for metabolic intermediates of DNA synthesis, so they are effective only during the S (synthesis) phase when DNA is being replicated; agents like alkylators act independent of cell-cycle phase.
explanation.whyCorrect: Antimetabolites are decoys for metabolic intermediates of DNA synthesis, so they are effective only during the S (synthesis) phase when DNA is being replicated; agents like alkylators act independent of cell-cycle phase.

questions.stem: This diagram maps the folate cycle that produces thymidine. What is the direct downstream consequence of the drug-mediated enzyme inhibition shown blocking dihydrofolate reductase?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Tetrahydrofolate cannot be regenerated, so dUMP is no longer converted to dTMP and DNA synthesis stalls

choices.label: B
choices.text: dTMP accumulates and feedback-inhibits thymidylate synthase to protect the cell

choices.label: C
choices.text: Excess tetrahydrofolate is shunted into increased purine synthesis

choices.label: D
choices.text: dUMP and dTMP become covalently crosslinked within the DNA strand

choices.label: E
choices.text: Thymidylate synthase is activated to bypass the folate requirement

explanation.summary: Inhibiting dihydrofolate reductase prevents regeneration of tetrahydrofolate, the cofactor thymidylate synthase needs to methylate dUMP into dTMP; without dTMP, DNA replication in dividing cells fails.
explanation.whyCorrect: Inhibiting dihydrofolate reductase prevents regeneration of tetrahydrofolate, the cofactor thymidylate synthase needs to methylate dUMP into dTMP; without dTMP, DNA replication in dividing cells fails.
